source_records.title: FiVE: A Fine-grained Video Editing Benchmark for Evaluating Emerging Diffusion and Rectified Flow Models (Wang, arXiv 2503.13684)
source_records.summary_text: First benchmark comparing diffusion vs rectified-flow video editing (5 diffusion vs Pyramid-Edit/Wan-Edit): 100 videos, 420 object-level pairs, 15 metrics; RF 10-15x faster per frame with competitive quality; FiVE-Acc VLM metric. Partially fills G12. [retrieval: SUMMARY_CAPTURED; full-body consumption at Evidence stage]
